about.title: Blogger Lamongan, based in the Indonesia
about.body1: Sudar is an independent software shop, based in Sofia, Bulgaria. As Eastern Europeans, we are capable of achieving optimal results with limited resources and that's reflected in our software. We work with the latest software stacks and we know cloud infrastructure well.
about.body2: We focus on security, performance, privacy, and shipping quality products. We're open to collaboration and we'd love to hear from you!

items.name: Scoold
items.title: Scoold | Sudar Blogger
items.tagline: Knowledge sharing for your team, inspired by the Stack Exchange platform
items.description: Scoold is open source and works great as a questions-and-answer platform, forum, knowledge base or customer support system. Self-hosted and open source.

items.name: Para
items.title: Para | Sudar Blogger
items.tagline: The open-source backend server for busy developers
items.description: Para helps teams prototype rapidly and ship internal tools and CRUD applications by providing a full-featured backend service.

items.name: Para Cloud
items.title: Para Cloud | Sudar Blogger
items.tagline: Fully managed Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) with global availability.
items.description: Para Cloud is fully managed backend service with global availability and failover. It provides Para backend hosting with a generous free tier.

items.name: Scoold Cloud
items.title: Scoold Cloud | Sudar Blogger
items.tagline: The easiest way to deploy a Scoold Pro instance. Fully managed service, with pre-configured email, storage and automatic backup & upgrades.
items.description: Scoold Cloud is the fully managed hosting service for Scoold Pro - the premium version of the popular q-and-a platform Scoold.

items.name: Scoold Pro
items.title: Scoold Pro | Sudar Blogger
items.tagline: Enterprise-ready Scoold with premium features and advanced auth flows (SAML, LDAP, OAuth2).
items.description: Scoold Pro - enterprise Q&A platform with SAML 2.0, LDAP, SCIM, and OAuth2 SSO. Advanced analytics, custom branding, and priority support. Self-hosted for full data control.

items.name: Robo Translator
items.title: Robo Translator | Sudar Blogger
items.tagline: Human-friendly content localization workflows for busy content creators.
items.description: Robo Translator is a cloud service tool for content localization, translation and transcription. It does text-to-speech, speech-to-text and closed captions.
